recreation_brief: 1. Set the slide background to white. 2. Add a yellow circle at the top-right, approx x 88-96%, y 3-11%, fill #FFFF00, no outline, black bold text 44. 3. Top-left: build a 6-column table/text grid headed x₁ x₂ x₃ x₄ x₅ x₆. Add rows (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6), then (1)(1)(2)(4)(5)(6), then (1)(1)(1)(2)(4)(5). Add a bottom class row C₁ C₁ C₁ C₂ C₂ C₂; color C₁ #0000FF and C₂ #FF0000. 4. Top-center: add black text Initial W = [4; -2]. To its right add red text Step η = 2. Add black text Check classes of above a blue-outlined matrix with headers Z₁ Z₁ Z₁ and rows (0)(7)(3), (0)(6)(2). Below it add C₁ positive, C₂ negative, Zero is unaccepted, coloring only C₁ blue and C₂ red. 5. Left-middle: add red bold caption Upgraded Vectors (from Top). Below it build the upgraded table headed x₁…x₆ with rows (1)(1)(1)(1)(1)(1), (1)(2)(1)(5)(6)(6), (1)(2)(4)(5)(6)(6), and class row C₁ C₁ C₁ C₂ C₂ C₂ using the same C₁/C₂ colors. 6. Add a red rounded rectangle under that table with white bold text Iteration 3. 7. Right side: place six equation rows from the equations field. Use black text; for d(x₁)-d(x₃) use ⇒ Update Weight, and for d(x₄)-d(x₆) use ⇒ Keep same Weight. Add left-pointing arrows at the far right of d(x₁)-d(x₃) only. 8. Keep all other text black except the specified red/blue accents; do not add extra bullets or titles.
